LESSON: GUIDED READING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: READING Theme 6: Foods and Drinks (Meals) Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Ou
Topic 2.8: Guided Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Reading, part of READING Theme 6: Foods and Drinks (Meals) Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Ou in Grade 5 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: Why do we stress words while reading them?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read aloud names of weather features and their appropriate weather patterns (z.B Die Sonne scheint jeden Tag/ Es ist sonnig),

2. read simple short texts on description of weather features and patterns,

3. read online texts on weather patterns and share new information with peers on social media platforms.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read aloud names of weather features and their appropriate weather patterns (z.B Die Sonne scheint jeden Tag/ Es ist sonnig),
2. read simple short texts on description of weather features and patterns,
3. read online texts on weather patterns and share new information with peers on social media platforms.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Digital literacy: Learner connects and uses technology as they read online texts on weather patterns and share new

information with peers on social media platforms.

Values:
Responsibility: Learner demonstrates awareness of what to do under different weather patterns as they read texts on the same.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Safety and Security: Learner develops strategies of keeping safe under varying weather patterns as they read texts and share

new information on weather patterns.

Link to other Learning Areas

The learner links the concept of weather patterns to the same concept in Social Studies.
